'''February 2001 Bridgewater tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Scholars', Bridgewater, MA on 23 February 2001. [[Steve Baroni]] won it. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1770">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-bridgewater-friday-23d1770/ bridgewater-friday-23], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-bridgewater-friday-23d1770/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Scholars', Bridgewater, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
